# holospot

> The holographic materials of holo.spot (diffraction foils, glitter, kinetic spirals, volume holograms, foil-embossed paper cards) for three.js scenes. Three calls: new Holo(renderer), holo.apply(mesh, { material, sizeMm }), holo.render(scene, camera).

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the whole manual on one page: API, settings, recipes, checks, limits

## Reference
- [docs/materials/prism.md](docs/materials/prism.md): Prism Rainbow
- [docs/materials/shatter.md](docs/materials/shatter.md): Gold Shatter
- [docs/materials/nebula.md](docs/materials/nebula.md): Nebula Glitter
- [docs/materials/sparkle.md](docs/materials/sparkle.md): Sky Sparkle
- [docs/materials/vortex.md](docs/materials/vortex.md): Gilded Vortex
- [docs/materials/volume.md](docs/materials/volume.md): Volume Hologram
- [docs/materials/emboss.md](docs/materials/emboss.md): Foil Emboss paper card, foil logos and hologram stickers
- [docs/scene-settings.md](docs/scene-settings.md): lights, display, grain, bump map, depth of field, card finish
- [schema/holo.schema.json](schema/holo.schema.json): every setting as JSON Schema
- [dist/holo.d.ts](dist/holo.d.ts): the API's types
